completed_tasks.name: Reset STATE.md for v2.0 GameModel milestone

decisions.decision: Replace all typed D&D Dart models with generic GameEntity (Map<String,dynamic> wrapper)
decisions.rationale: Typed classes encode D&D assumptions at the type level — can't extend for other TTRPGs without forking
Human-readable, importable, matches existing wiki persistence format

decisions.decision: Call of Cthulhu 7e as second bundled model (agnosticism proof)
decisions.rationale: Structurally very different from D&D — percentile skills, Sanity, no CR/XP — validates true agnosticism

decisions.decision: WikiPageType enum replaced by runtime isWikiPageType flag in GameModel entityTypes
decisions.rationale: Enum is compile-time D&D only; runtime registry supports any set of page types a GameModel defines

decisions.decision: No new core dependencies — rootBundle + provider + dart:convert only
decisions.rationale: file_picker goes in apps only; all pub.dev form-gen packages are dead (9–54 downloads)

next_action: Run /clear then /gsd-discuss-phase 5 to begin Phase 5: Core Data Layer (GameModel, GameEntity, FieldSchema pure-Dart data classes)
